{{Quote|Those are Arkudan gaming cubes. They're supposed to bring luck, but I just keep them because they're centuries old, and I like the way they look.|Tionne Solusar on Arkudan gaming cubes|<ref name="Kenobi's Blade">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Kenobi's Blade]]''</ref>}}
The '''Arkudans''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]], [[Homeworld/Legends|native]] to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Arkuda]], located in the [[Gordian Reach/Legends|Gordian Reach]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. They were a squat species, with vaguely [[Bear/Legends|ursine]] characteristics.<ref name="Atlas" /> 

For hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior<ref name="Kenobi's Blade" /> to [[22 ABY/Legends|22 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> the Arkudans produced [[Arkudan gaming cube|gaming cubes]] that were jewelled and highly ornamental.<ref name="Atlas" /> These cubes were believed by some to bring good [[luck]],<ref name="Kenobi's Blade" /> and it was primarily for these cubes that the Arkudans were known.<ref name="Atlas" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Tionne Solusar]] owned a pair fluffy Arkudan gaming cubes, which she hung from the ceiling of her [[Starship/Legends|starship]], the ''[[Lore Seeker]]''.<ref name="Kenobi's Blade" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Arkudans were first mentioned as part of the name "Arkudan gaming cubes" in the ''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Kenobi's Blade]]'', the sixth and final book in the ''[[Star Wars: Junior Jedi Knights]]'' series. The book was written by [[Rebecca Moesta]] and released in [[1997]].<ref name="Kenobi's Blade" /> The Arkudans were first identified as a species in the [[2009]] source book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]].<ref name="Atlas" />
